tests.title: A draft spec can be edited and saved
given: a spec in the draft state
tests.when: the PRD body is changed and Save is called
then: the written prd.md carries the new body

tests.title: An unknown lifecycle transition is rejected
given: a spec in the draft state
tests.when: Transition is called with a state outside the lifecycle graph
then: the spec on disk is unchanged
tests.pseudocode: _, err = s.Transition('bogus', dir); assert err != nil

tests.title: An operator edits a draft spec end to end
given: a draft spec directory on disk
tests.when: the Intent section is edited and the spec is saved and reloaded
then: the reloaded body carries the edit
